map.对周期信号 f(t) 计算傅里叶系数 aₙ/bₙ、直流分量 a₀ 与三角/指数形: For a periodic signal f(t), compute Fourier coefficients an/bn, DC component a0, and the trigonometric/exponential Fourier series expansion.
map.周期信号的基频为其周期的倒数。: The fundamental frequency of a periodic signal is the reciprocal of its period.
map.周期 20 ms 对应 50 Hz 基频。: A period of 20 ms corresponds to a 50 Hz fundamental.
map.周期信号周期 T 求基频 f0。: Find the fundamental f0 from period T of a periodic signal.
map.傅里叶级数展开的频率基准。: The frequency reference for Fourier series expansion.
map.谐波频率为基频整数倍。: Harmonic frequencies are integer multiples of the fundamental.
map.基频 f0 = 1 / 0.02 = 50 Hz；二次谐波 100Hz、三次 1: Fundamental f0 = 1 / 0.02 = 50 Hz; second harmonic 100Hz, third 150Hz.
map.若 T=0.04s，则 f0=25Hz，基频降一半、谐波同步下移。: If T=0.04s, then f0=25Hz, the fundamental drops by half and the harmonics shift down accordingly.
map.基频与角频率关系？: What is the relation between fundamental and angular frequency?
map.非周期信号有基频吗？: Does a non-periodic signal have a fundamental?
map.严格非周期（单段）用傅里叶变换得连续谱，无离散基频。: A strictly non-periodic (single segment) signal uses the Fourier transform to get a continuous spectrum, with no discrete fundamental.
map.周期信号基频：基频 f₀ = 1 ÷ T（Hz，T 为周期 s）；联动量：角频率: Periodic signal fundamental frequency: f₀ = 1 ÷ T (Hz, T the period in s); linked values: angular frequency ω = 2π·f₀ (rad/s), time constant 1÷ω = 1 ÷ max(2πf₀,10⁻⁹) (s), half period = T÷2 (s). Validation: required guard for the period T, which as a denominator must not be 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; a shorter period gives a higher fundamental, and angular frequency is proportional to the fundamental (by 2π).
